inspiration.observed_pattern: A CTE builds conditional bit masks with MAX(CASE ...) and BIT_OR(CASE ...), then a CROSS JOIN applies bitwise membership tests in a prioritized CASE classification and repeats those predicates in WHERE.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a capability classification report with new catalog and subject tables, masks, labels, and rows. Communication and operations masks are conditionally aggregated, then each agent is classified by bitwise intersection; unmatched agents are filtered out and results have deterministic ordering.

fixture_notes: Capability bits are mail=1, chat=2, export=4, audit=8, and admin=16. Alice has mail plus export and is classified hybrid; Bob has chat and is communication; Carol has export plus audit and is operations; Dave has only admin and is filtered out.
determinism_notes: Capability masks, agent identifiers, classification precedence, repeated predicates, and ordering are fixed. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE capability_catalog (capability_name VARCHAR(16) PRIMARY KEY, capability_group VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, capability_mask INT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE capability_agents (agent_id INT PRIMARY KEY, agent_email VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, capability_mask INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: WITH masks AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN capability_name = 'mail' THEN capability_mask ELSE NULL END) AS mail_mask, BIT_OR(CASE WHEN capability_group = 'communication' THEN capability_mask ELSE 0 END) AS communication_mask, BIT_OR(CASE WHEN capability_group = 'operations' THEN capability_mask ELSE 0 END) AS operations_mask FROM capability_catalog) SELECT CASE WHEN (a.capability_mask & m.mail_mask) != 0 AND (a.capability_mask & m.operations_mask) != 0 THEN 'hybrid' WHEN (a.capability_mask & m.communication_mask) != 0 THEN 'communication' WHEN (a.capability_mask & m.operations_mask) != 0 THEN 'operations' END AS classification, a.agent_id, a.agent_email FROM capability_agents a CROSS JOIN masks m WHERE ((a.capability_mask & m.mail_mask) != 0 AND (a.capability_mask & m.operations_mask) != 0) OR ((a.capability_mask & m.communication_mask) != 0) OR ((a.capability_mask & m.operations_mask) != 0) ORDER BY classification, a.agent_id

checks.sql: SELECT agent_id, agent_email, capability_mask FROM capability_agents ORDER BY agent_id
